PLAN "Integrated 12-Week Strength, Cardio, and Mobility (Meniscus-Safe Peak by Week 12)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "return to skiing with stronger legs, posterior chain, and core via low-impact strength, varied cardio, and mobility"

      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A (meniscus-safe)":

          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 32m "Rowing Intervals (intro) + Mobility":

          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12x40 rpe 7 rest 20 seconds
          calf_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
        cooldown:
          walking 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
